roadmap.title: Standard campaign and route setup
roadmap.description: Clear all four episodes on a standard difficulty. Collect opportunistic medals, prepare the Episode Three sewer item, complete one-run challenges, and use opposite Episode Four lever choices across two runs.

roadmap.title: All campaign medals
roadmap.description: Replay Claire's and Barry's halves as needed to finish all twenty medals in each episode; individual medals persist between completed runs.

roadmap.title: Countdown clears
roadmap.description: Buy each Countdown episode from Extras > Rewards for 1,000 BP, then clear all four while using kills and hourglasses to maintain the timer.

roadmap.title: Invisible clears
roadmap.description: Buy and clear each Invisible episode, using Moira's flashlight and Natalia's pointing to reveal enemies before attacking with Claire or Barry.

roadmap.title: Combat counters and Raid cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the Episode One and Two checkpoint farms for remaining campaign counters, then complete a Raid mission, evaluate one item, and clear one Gauntlet.

achievements.description: Clear Episode One.
achievements.summary: Complete both the @npc{Claire and Moira} and @npc{Barry and Natalia} halves of @loc{Episode One}.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and has no difficulty restriction.

steps.text: Select @loc{Episode One}, finish Claire's detention-center escape, then finish Barry's return through the same area to complete the episode.

achievements.description: Clear Episode One in Countdown Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode One} in @mechanic{Countdown Mode} before the timer expires.

guide.context: After a standard Episode One clear, buy this variant for @item{1,000 BP} in @mechanic{Extras > Rewards}; enemy kills and hourglasses add time.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Countdown Mode: Episode One}, take efficient story routes, collect nearby hourglasses, kill quick targets for time, and finish both Claire's and Barry's segments before the clock reaches zero.

achievements.description: Clear Episode One in Invisible Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode One} in @mechanic{Invisible Mode}.

guide.context: After a standard Episode One clear, buy this variant for @item{1,000 BP} in @mechanic{Extras > Rewards}; enemies are hidden from Claire and Barry.

steps.text: Use @npc{Moira's flashlight} and @npc{Natalia's pointing} to reveal targets, switch to Claire or Barry to attack, and finish both Episode One segments.

achievements.description: Get all medals in Episode One.
achievements.summary: Earn all @item{20 medals} across Claire's and Barry's completed @loc{Episode One} runs.

guide.context: Each requirement must be completed within one finished character segment, but already-earned medals persist across repeat runs, so incompatible conditions can be split up.

collectibles.name: Claire: five light knockdowns
collectibles.method: Fully blind an enemy with Moira's flashlight, switch to Claire, and use the physical-attack prompt five times.

collectibles.name: Claire: eight rotating-blade kills
collectibles.method: Activate the rotating blades, draw Afflicted into their sweep, and let the trap kill eight enemies.

collectibles.name: Claire: ten flashlight stuns
collectibles.method: Control Moira and hold her flashlight on enemies until ten full stun reactions occur.

collectibles.name: Claire: eight sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Use exploding or firebomb bottles to kill eight enemies; clustered Afflicted and Giant Whip Spiders are efficient targets.

collectibles.name: Claire: three stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind three unaware enemies as Claire and use the stealth-attack prompt.

collectibles.name: Claire: eight headshot kills
collectibles.method: Finish eight enemies with bullets to the head while controlling Claire.

collectibles.name: Claire: three treasures
collectibles.method: Explore side rooms and break containers until three treasure pickups register during the run.

collectibles.name: Claire: ten Giant Whip Spiders
collectibles.method: Kill ten Giant Whip Spiders in the story-required garbage-pit swarm; one exploding bottle can clear most of them.

collectibles.name: Claire: three military boxes
collectibles.method: Use Moira's crowbar lock-picking interaction to open all three military boxes before finishing Claire's segment.

collectibles.name: Claire: six hidden items
collectibles.method: Aim Moira's flashlight at sparkling concealed pickups and collect six revealed items.

collectibles.name: Barry: five weak-spot Revenants
collectibles.method: Use Natalia to identify each Revenant's glowing core, then expose and destroy only that core with Barry for five kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: no gunfire in control area
collectibles.method: From Natalia's warning about seeing monsters through walls until both characters leave the facility, use Natalia for routing and Barry's knife only; never fire a gun.

collectibles.name: Barry: fifteen brick hits
collectibles.method: Control Natalia, collect loose bricks, and hit enemies fifteen times; hits count even when they do not kill.

collectibles.name: Barry: two follow-up kills
collectibles.method: Knock enemies to the floor with Natalia's bricks, switch to Barry, and use his ground-finisher prompt for two kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: eight sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Kill eight enemies with exploding, firebomb, decoy, or smoke-assisted bottles while controlling Barry.

collectibles.name: Barry: six stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind six unaware enemies with Barry and use the stealth-attack prompt.

collectibles.name: Barry: six knife kills
collectibles.method: Kill six enemies with ordinary knife slashes; ground follow-ups do not count as knife kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: two gimmick boxes
collectibles.method: Use Natalia's lock interaction to open both gimmick boxes before finishing the segment.

collectibles.name: Barry: six hidden items
collectibles.method: Use Natalia's pointing ability to reveal six concealed pickups, then collect them.

collectibles.name: Barry: dark forest in 40 seconds
collectibles.location: From the detour hut to the next area
collectibles.method: Control Barry as he exits the detour hut, sprint along the direct forest route without switching to Natalia, and cross the next-area transition within 40 seconds.

achievements.description: Get a total of 50,000 BP.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative @item{50,000 BP} in the main campaign.

guide.context: The achievement tracks BP earned rather than the balance currently held, and campaign medals provide substantial BP during normal completion.

steps.text: Finish episodes and medal conditions until the main-campaign total reaches @item{50,000 BP}; spend BP freely because purchases do not reduce cumulative credit.

achievements.description: Escape from the detention center in Claire's Episode One without using the flame-thrower bust.
achievements.summary: Escape Claire's @loc{Episode One detention center} without touching the flamethrower-bust valve.

guide.context: The right-side valve immediately invalidates the attempt; the rotating blades remain safe to use.

steps.text: Insert the golden cog to open the prison cells, then leave the flamethrower valve untouched.
Switch to Moira and pry the boards from the exit while Claire fights the Afflicted or both characters crouch beneath the rotating blade so the trap kills them.
Move both characters through Moira's opened door to leave the detention center and receive the achievement.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 Afflicted in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{100 Afflicted} across Claire's main-campaign episodes.

guide.context: Afflicted belong to Claire's campaign; Raid Mode enemies do not contribute.

steps.text: At the end of @loc{Claire Episode One}, kill the two Afflicted that spawn repeatedly after the first wave until the cumulative campaign counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 Revenants in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{100 Revenants} across Barry's main-campaign episodes.

guide.context: Revenants belong to Barry's campaign; damage their exposed weak cores for fast kills.

steps.text: Replay Barry's episodes or reload the @loc{Episode One yellow-gate ambush}, use Natalia to locate each core, and kill Revenants with Barry until the cumulative total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Defeat 100 enemies with the knife in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{100 campaign enemies} with Claire's or Barry's knife.

guide.context: Both combat characters contribute to the same counter, but follow-up finishers are tracked separately.

steps.text: Use ordinary knife slashes to finish weak enemies, farming the infinitely spawning Afflicted at the end of @loc{Claire Episode One} if normal play leaves the total below 100.

achievements.description: Defeat 50 enemies with physical attacks in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{50 campaign enemies} with Claire's or Barry's physical attacks.

guide.context: The physical strike must deliver the kill; merely knocking an enemy down does not add to this counter.

steps.text: Fully stun an Afflicted with Moira's flashlight, switch to Claire, and use the physical-attack prompt as the finishing blow; repeat on the infinite pair at the end of @loc{Claire Episode One}.

achievements.description: Perform 50 follow-ups in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Perform @mechanic{50 follow-up finishers} on grounded campaign enemies.

guide.context: A follow-up is the prompted ground attack, not Barry's charged punch or an ordinary knife slash.

steps.text: Knock enemies down with Moira's light or crowbar, or with Natalia's bricks.
Switch to Claire or Barry and use the displayed ground-finisher prompt before each target stands; repeat until 50 follow-ups register.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with stealth attacks in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{20 unaware campaign enemies} with stealth attacks.

guide.context: Barry has the most reliable stealth sections, although Claire can also contribute when an enemy has not detected her.

steps.text: Crouch, approach directly behind an unaware enemy, and use the stealth-attack prompt; repeat across Barry's campaign or Episode Select until 20 kills register.

achievements.description: Use Moira's light to stun 50 enemies in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Fully stun @enemy{50 campaign enemies} with Moira's flashlight.

guide.context: Briefly illuminating a target is insufficient; credit comes from the full stagger animation after sustained light exposure.

steps.text: Control Moira, hold the flashlight on an enemy's face until it visibly enters the full stun state, let durable targets recover, and repeat until 50 stuns register.

achievements.description: Use Moira's crowbar to defeat 50 enemies in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{50 campaign enemies} while directly controlling Moira and using her crowbar.

guide.context: Only crowbar finishing damage contributes; Claire's physical follow-ups are a different counter.

steps.text: Use Moira's crowbar to finish weak or softened enemies, farming the infinite Afflicted at the end of @loc{Claire Episode One} until 50 kills register.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 enemies with a brick as Natalia in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{20 campaign enemies} while directly controlling Natalia and throwing bricks.

guide.context: Bricks are consumed on impact, so crawling Rotten are ideal because one clean hit commonly kills them.

steps.text: During Barry's episodes, collect a brick with Natalia, throw it at a crawling or weakened enemy for the finishing hit, and repeat until 20 kills register.

achievements.description: Clear Episode One only using the knife.
achievements.sortReason: The safest route avoids every reported hidden-rule risk.
achievements.summary: Clear both halves of @loc{Episode One} while your controlled characters damage enemies only with knives.

guide.context: The game applies hidden restrictions inconsistently, so the safest run avoids every optional non-knife action; rotating-blade trap kills are reported safe.

steps.text: As Claire and Moira, use Claire's knife only: do not attack with guns, bottles, Moira's flashlight or crowbar, stealth prompts, physical follow-ups, or the flamethrower valve.
As Barry and Natalia, use Barry's knife only: do not fire guns, throw or point Natalia's bricks at enemies, use bottles, perform stealth attacks, or trigger follow-up finishers.
Minimize combat, use rotating blades where available, and finish Barry's Episode One segment without restarting the run under looser rules.

achievements.description: Defeat two enemies with one shot in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{two campaign enemies} with one penetrating bullet.

guide.context: Barry's Python has enough power and penetration to make the setup reliable against weak enemies.

steps.text: Near the start of @loc{Barry Episode One}, position two weak enemies in a straight line and fire one Python round through both so the same shot kills them.

achievements.description: Destroy 30 Revenants' weapon arms.
achievements.summary: Shoot off @enemy{30 large blade weapon arms} from Revenants in the main campaign.

guide.context: Only the prominent blade arm counts; small spikes and sword-like growths do not.

steps.text: Reach the locked yellow gate near the end of @loc{Barry Episode One} and inspect it to trigger the Revenant ambush.
Shoot the large blade arm off each of the two qualifying Revenants, restart the checkpoint after both breaks, and repeat until 30 arms register.

achievements.description: Shoot down 30 Afflicted in mid-jump in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Shoot @enemy{30 Afflicted} out of their forward leap in the main campaign.

guide.context: The bullet must connect while the Afflicted is airborne in its attack animation.

steps.text: At the end of @loc{Claire Episode One}, face the infinitely spawning pair, wait for an Afflicted to leap, and fire the shotgun while it is airborne; repeat until 30 interruptions register.

achievements.description: Have Moira stun an enemy and Claire follow up with a physical attack in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Fully stagger a target with Moira's light, then make Claire connect with the displayed physical strike.

guide.context: The target does not need to die; the achievement checks the two-character action sequence.

steps.text: Control Moira and hold the flashlight on an enemy until it fully staggers, immediately switch to Claire, and use the physical-attack prompt before the stun ends.

achievements.description: Save your captured partner ten times in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Free a grabbed campaign partner @mechanic{10 times}.

guide.context: The same encounter can supply repeated rescues if the partner is allowed to be captured again.

steps.text: Control Moira, let an Afflicted grab her, switch to Claire and attack the captor to free Moira, then repeat until ten rescues register.

achievements.description: Defeat five enemies with one exploding bottle or one firebomb bottle in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill at least @enemy{five enemies} with one exploding or firebomb bottle in the campaign.

guide.context: The Episode One garbage pit contains enough small enemies to make one blast reliable.

steps.text: In @loc{Claire Episode One}, collect and save the exploding bottle beside the rusty key.
In the later garbage pit, reach the center before the AI partner thins the swarm, let at least five Giant Whip Spiders cluster, and throw the saved bottle into them.

achievements.description: Clear one Raid Mode mission.
achievements.summary: Finish any single mission selected from a red door in the @mechanic{Raid Mode} hub.

guide.context: This is Raid Mode's introductory completion task and does not require an entire Gauntlet.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Raid Mode}, interact with a red mission door in the hub, select an available mission, and complete its final objective.

achievements.description: Evaluate an item in Raid Mode.
achievements.summary: Evaluate one unidentified Raid item at the hub's jukebox.

guide.context: Weapons and parts recovered from mission chests remain unidentified until the jukebox appraisal is used.

steps.text: Complete a Raid mission after collecting a chest that awards an unidentified weapon or part.
Return to the Raid hub, interact with the jukebox beside the red mission doors, and pay to evaluate that item.

achievements.description: Clear one Gauntlet in Raid Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete every mission node in any one @mechanic{Raid Mode Gauntlet}.

guide.context: A Gauntlet is the grouped series shown behind one red mission door, not a single node.

steps.text: Open a red mission door, choose one Gauntlet, and finish each of its mission nodes until the group shows complete.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Two.
achievements.summary: Complete both the @npc{Claire and Moira} and @npc{Barry and Natalia} halves of @loc{Episode Two}.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and has no difficulty restriction.

steps.text: Finish Claire's village and city route, then complete Barry's return through those areas to clear Episode Two.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Two in Countdown Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Two} in @mechanic{Countdown Mode} before the timer expires.

guide.context: Buy the mode for @item{1,000 BP} after a standard Episode Two clear; interaction animations can conserve clock time during the village assault.

steps.text: Collect nearby hourglasses, kill quick enemies for time, use direct objective routes through Claire's and Barry's segments, and finish Episode Two before the clock expires.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Two in Invisible Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Two} in @mechanic{Invisible Mode}.

guide.context: Moira and Natalia expose hidden targets, allowing the combat partner to aim at their marked position.

steps.text: Reveal each threat with Moira's flashlight or Natalia's pointing, switch to Claire or Barry for necessary kills, and finish both Episode Two segments.

achievements.description: Get all medals in Episode Two.
achievements.summary: Earn all @item{20 medals} across Claire's and Barry's completed @loc{Episode Two} runs.

guide.context: Medals persist between finished repeat runs. Killing Pedro as Claire removes him from Barry's segment, so reserve one Claire run for the achievement and another route for Barry's six-eye medal.

collectibles.name: Claire: five light knockdowns
collectibles.method: Blind an enemy fully with Moira, switch to Claire, and use the physical prompt five times.

collectibles.name: Claire: intact bar windows
collectibles.method: Kill attackers before they finish breaking any window, prioritizing every enemy striking the exterior boards.

collectibles.name: Claire: ten flashlight stuns
collectibles.method: Control Moira and hold the flashlight on enemies until ten full stuns register.

collectibles.name: Claire: eight sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Climb to a safe ledge and throw bottles into clustered enemies until eight sub-weapon kills register.

collectibles.name: Claire: three stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind three unaware enemies as Claire and perform the stealth prompt.

collectibles.name: Claire: eight headshot kills
collectibles.method: Finish eight enemies with shots to the head while controlling Claire.

collectibles.name: Claire: craft three sub-weapons
collectibles.method: Collect compatible bottle ingredients and combine them into three sub-weapons during the run.

collectibles.name: Claire: three military boxes
collectibles.method: Open three military boxes with Moira's crowbar lock interaction.

collectibles.name: Claire: six hidden items
collectibles.method: Reveal six sparkling concealed pickups with Moira's flashlight and collect them.

collectibles.name: Claire: escape Pedro unharmed
collectibles.method: Keep the bar counter between Claire and Mutant Pedro, move away when the exit opens, and climb Neil's ladder without Pedro damaging Claire.

collectibles.name: Barry: five weak-spot Revenants
collectibles.method: Locate each core with Natalia and let Barry damage only the exposed core for five kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: destroy Pedro's six eyes
collectibles.method: Leave Pedro alive as Claire; on Normal or above, reveal each eye with Natalia and shoot it with Barry's low-damage weapon until all six break before Pedro dies.

collectibles.name: Barry: fifteen brick hits
collectibles.method: Control Natalia and land fifteen thrown-brick hits on enemies.

collectibles.name: Barry: two follow-up kills
collectibles.location: Barry Episode Two on Normal or higher
collectibles.method: Bring at least two exploding bottles. Throw one beside each of two separate Revenants to knock them down, and use Barry's prompted ground finisher on both before they recover; restart the run if either blast fails to cause a knockdown.

collectibles.name: Barry: eight sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Kill eight enemies with bottles; explosive bottles can kill Glasps even when the blast is slightly off-center.

collectibles.name: Barry: six stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind six unaware enemies and use Barry's stealth-attack prompt.

collectibles.name: Barry: six knife kills
collectibles.method: Finish six enemies with normal Barry knife slashes rather than follow-up attacks.

collectibles.name: Barry: three gimmick boxes
collectibles.method: Use Natalia to unlock all three gimmick boxes during the segment.

collectibles.name: Barry: six hidden items
collectibles.method: Point out and collect six concealed items with Natalia.

collectibles.name: Barry: five warehouse stealth kills
collectibles.method: Remain undetected inside the warehouse and stealth-kill five Revenants from behind before leaving it.

achievements.description: Defeat Mutant Pedro in Claire's Episode Two.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Mutant Pedro} as Claire after the @loc{Episode Two bar siege} and before escaping by ladder.

guide.context: This route removes Pedro from Barry's later segment, so use a different completed Claire run when pursuing Barry's six-eye medal.

steps.text: Carry the Double Barrel Shotgun, MP-AB50, and several exploding bottles into the village sequence.
After Pedro mutates, keep away from his drill, punish him when the drill sticks in a wall, and kill him before climbing Neil's escape ladder.

achievements.displayName: "I Do Not Like Glasps," I Gasped
achievements.description: Defeat 20 Glasps in the main campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{20 Glasps} across the main campaign.

guide.context: Glasps are nearly invisible; Natalia can identify their position and smoke bottles expose them.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Barry Episode Two} after entering the village, locate and kill the nearby Glasp, then reload the checkpoint and repeat until the cumulative total reaches 20.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Three.
achievements.summary: Complete both the @npc{Claire and Moira} and @npc{Barry and Natalia} halves of @loc{Episode Three}.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and has no difficulty restriction.

steps.text: Finish Claire's factory and Neil sequence, then complete Barry's sewer and tower route to clear Episode Three.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Three in Countdown Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Three} in @mechanic{Countdown Mode} before the timer expires.

guide.context: Buy this variant for @item{1,000 BP} after the standard clear; its long factory and sewer routes reward memorized objectives over optional combat.

steps.text: Follow the direct objective route, collect reachable hourglasses, kill only quick time-positive targets, and finish Claire's and Barry's Episode Three segments before the timer expires.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Three in Invisible Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Three} in @mechanic{Invisible Mode}.

guide.context: Partner vision is essential around Glasps and Revenant cores, while unnecessary encounters can be bypassed.

steps.text: Reveal enemies with Moira or Natalia, switch to Claire or Barry for mandatory fights, bypass optional threats, and finish both Episode Three segments.

achievements.description: Get all medals in Episode Three.
achievements.summary: Earn all @item{20 medals} across Claire's and Barry's completed @loc{Episode Three} runs.

guide.context: Already-earned medals persist after a finished run, letting speed, crafting, no-damage, and combat requirements be separated.

collectibles.name: Claire: five light knockdowns
collectibles.method: Fully blind enemies with Moira and use Claire's physical prompt five times.

collectibles.name: Claire: factory escape with over one minute
collectibles.method: Memorize the exit route and cross the factory escape endpoint with more than 60 seconds remaining.

collectibles.name: Claire: twenty flashlight stuns
collectibles.method: Control Moira and produce twenty complete flashlight-stun reactions.

collectibles.name: Claire: ten sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Use bottles to finish ten enemies, targeting clustered weak enemies where possible.

collectibles.name: Claire: three stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind and stealth-kill three unaware enemies as Claire.

collectibles.name: Claire: ten headshot kills
collectibles.method: Finish ten enemies with headshots while controlling Claire.

collectibles.name: Claire: craft five sub-weapons
collectibles.method: Combine collected bottle ingredients into five sub-weapons before the segment ends.

collectibles.name: Claire: craft five recovery items
collectibles.method: Combine herbs or other compatible recovery ingredients five times during the run.

collectibles.name: Claire: four military boxes
collectibles.method: Open all four military boxes using Moira's crowbar lock interaction.

collectibles.name: Claire: seven hidden items
collectibles.method: Reveal and collect seven concealed pickups with Moira's flashlight.

collectibles.name: Barry: three weak-spot Revenants
collectibles.method: Use Natalia to find each core and let Barry damage only that core for three Revenant kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: preserve every Dhurlga tentacle
collectibles.method: During each Dhurlga fight, aim damage at the body and complete the segment without severing any tentacle.

collectibles.name: Barry: fifteen brick hits
collectibles.method: Control Natalia and hit enemies with thrown bricks fifteen times.

collectibles.name: Barry: three follow-up kills
collectibles.method: Knock enemies down with Natalia's bricks, switch to Barry, and use three prompted ground finishers.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Kill ten enemies with Barry's bottle sub-weapons.

collectibles.name: Barry: four stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind four unaware enemies and execute Barry's stealth attack.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten knife kills
collectibles.method: Finish ten enemies with ordinary knife slashes, not ground follow-ups.

collectibles.name: Barry: three gimmick boxes
collectibles.method: Use Natalia's lock interaction to open three gimmick boxes.

collectibles.name: Barry: five hidden items
collectibles.method: Reveal and collect five concealed pickups with Natalia's pointing ability.

collectibles.name: Barry: Natalia unharmed in sewage plant
collectibles.method: Keep Natalia away from attackers and complete the entire treatment-plant section without her taking damage.

achievements.description: Moira defeats Neil in Claire's Episode Three.
achievements.summary: During Claire's @loc{Episode Three} finale, switch to Moira and have her shoot @enemy{Neil} in the interactive sequence.

guide.context: Claire may damage Neil throughout the actual boss fight; only the character chosen for the final dropped-gun interaction matters.

steps.text: Defeat Neil's boss phase as Claire by attacking the exposed yellow growth in his chest.
After leaving the elevator, ignore Claire's prompt to pick up the dropped gun, switch to Moira, and use Moira's button prompt to shoot Neil.

achievements.description: Obtain the item that lies beyond the gate in the sewers in Barry's Episode Three.
achievements.summary: Prepare the sewer cage as Moira, then collect the gated upgrade part as Barry in @loc{Episode Three}.

guide.context: Claire's completed sewer state carries into Barry's later visit; leaving before finishing Claire's segment can prevent the cage from appearing.

steps.text: In Claire's sewers after the burning building, boost Moira onto the wall with the yellow ledge, pick up the cage above, drop it to the lower floor, and complete Claire's segment.
When Barry returns to the same sewer room, carry the cage to the wall opposite Claire's climb, place it as a step, climb over the gate, and collect the upgrade part.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Four.
achievements.summary: Complete both the @npc{Claire and Moira} and @npc{Barry and Natalia} halves of @loc{Episode Four}.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress; the ending route does not impose a difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Finish Claire's monument escape, then complete Barry's mine, landfill, crane, and final-boss route to clear Episode Four.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Four in Countdown Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Four} in @mechanic{Countdown Mode} before the timer expires.

guide.context: Buy the variant for @item{1,000 BP} after the standard clear; Episode Four's long Barry route makes direct navigation and clock pickups especially important.

steps.text: Sprint Claire's monument route, then follow Barry's shortest objective path while collecting hourglasses and quick kill bonuses until both segments are complete.

achievements.description: Clear Episode Four in Invisible Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete both halves of @loc{Episode Four} in @mechanic{Invisible Mode}.

guide.context: Natalia can expose Revenant cores and invisible Glasps; bypassing optional enemies reduces risk in Barry's long segment.

steps.text: Use Moira and Natalia to reveal mandatory threats, switch to Claire or Barry for attacks, avoid unnecessary fights, and finish both Episode Four segments.

achievements.displayName: I'm Not Leaving Without My Medal
achievements.description: Get all medals in Episode Four.
achievements.summary: Earn all @item{20 medals} across Claire's and Barry's completed @loc{Episode Four} runs.

guide.context: Split conflicting goals across completed repeats: Claire's accuracy, knife Glasp, speed, and no-retry medals need not share one run, and Barry's no-damage fight can be isolated.

collectibles.name: Claire: 100% accuracy
collectibles.method: Fire only guaranteed shots; every fired round must hit an enemy before the segment ends.

collectibles.name: Claire: knife one Glasp
collectibles.method: Use Moira's light to track a Glasp, switch to Claire, close the distance, and deliver the killing blow with the knife.

collectibles.name: Claire: two military boxes
collectibles.method: Open both military boxes with Moira's crowbar lock interaction.

collectibles.name: Claire: no retries
collectibles.method: Finish Claire's entire segment without dying or selecting Retry from a checkpoint.

collectibles.name: Claire: three Glasp kills
collectibles.method: Reveal Glasps with Moira and kill at least three with Claire before escaping the monument.

collectibles.name: Claire: monument escape with 15 seconds
collectibles.method: Use the direct escape route and reach safety with more than 15 seconds left on the escape timer.

collectibles.name: Claire: five indigenous animals
collectibles.method: Search the short outdoor route and kill five small native animals before the segment ends.

collectibles.name: Claire: four treasures
collectibles.method: Search side rooms and break containers until four treasure pickups register.

collectibles.name: Claire: all three Tower Emblems
collectibles.method: Locate and shoot all three blue Tower Emblems during Claire's segment.

collectibles.name: Claire: clear within 20 minutes
collectibles.method: Ignore optional pickups, follow the direct monument route, and complete Claire's segment in under 20 minutes.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten weak-spot Revenants
collectibles.method: Use Natalia to identify each core and let Barry damage only the exposed core for ten Revenant kills.

collectibles.name: Barry: defeat Alex unharmed
collectibles.method: Enter with strong weapons and bottles, avoid every attack, and defeat Alex without Barry taking damage.

collectibles.name: Barry: fifteen brick hits
collectibles.method: Control Natalia and land fifteen thrown-brick hits on enemies.

collectibles.name: Barry: five follow-up kills
collectibles.method: Knock enemies down with Natalia's bricks, switch to Barry, and perform five prompted ground finishers.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten sub-weapon kills
collectibles.method: Use Barry's bottles to kill ten enemies during the segment.

collectibles.name: Barry: five stealth kills
collectibles.method: Crouch behind and stealth-kill five unaware enemies as Barry.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten knife kills
collectibles.method: Finish ten enemies with normal knife slashes rather than follow-up attacks.

collectibles.name: Barry: three gimmick boxes
collectibles.method: Use Natalia's lock interaction to open all three gimmick boxes.

collectibles.name: Barry: ten hidden items
collectibles.method: Reveal and collect ten concealed pickups with Natalia's pointing ability.

collectibles.name: Barry: crane in three moves
collectibles.method: Put Natalia on the platform and pull lever 1 with Barry; move Natalia onto the crane and pull lever 3; lower her ladder, move Barry across, pull lever 5, and lower the final ladder.

achievements.displayName: What You Can't See Can Kill You
achievements.description: Defeat six or more Glasps in the monument in Claire's Episode Four, on Normal difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: On @mechanic{Normal difficulty or higher}, kill at least @enemy{six Glasps} in one Claire @loc{Episode Four monument} run.

guide.context: Casual spawns only four Glasps, while Normal and harder settings place seven in the monument, giving one spare target.

steps.text: Start Claire Episode Four on @mechanic{Normal} or a harder difficulty.
Use Moira's flashlight to locate each Glasp, switch to Claire to kill it, and defeat six before completing the monument escape.

achievements.description: Complete both routes through the landfill in Barry's Episode Four.
achievements.summary: Reach Barry's @loc{Episode Four landfill} once after pulling Claire's opening lever and once after leaving it untouched.

guide.context: The lever in Claire's monitor room changes Barry's later landfill path; Steam patch 2.30 fixed the original unlock failure.

steps.text: At the start of Claire Episode Four, enter the monitor room, use the lever in the small room to the left, finish Claire's segment, and advance Barry to the landfill.
Replay Episode Four, leave the same monitor-room lever untouched, finish Claire's segment again, and advance Barry to the landfill by the alternate route.
